## Hard stops (this product)
- Lines the screening table marks ❌ / Hard NO conflict: never. Everything that is not a Hard NO is wording, and wording is free.
- Spark is on-demand intimacy support for men and women: PT-141 + Apomorphine + Tadalafil in one sublingual tablet.
  **Never tie a benefit to one ingredient**: name the three together as a combo, or not at all. "ED" only in the bible's ⏳ ED
  headlines with explicit approval; no "erectile", "Viagra", "Cialis", "instant", no timing promises ("tonight", "in minutes"),
  no guarantees. Mechanism first; "supports", never "builds"/"boosts".
- **No beds or bedroom scenes**, no lingerie, no body shots, no couples in bed, no before/after. A person (only when asked) is
  clothed, candid, 30–65, shoulder-up or waist-up, in a daytime setting (kitchen, hallway, terrace, café, car, garden).
- Form: copy may say "sublingual tablet" / "easy sublingual delivery"; never a strength, dose or count. Exactly one tablet.
  No needles, syringes or vials.
- No "Are you/Do you…?" questions, no first person, no named competitors, no "clinically studied" for the product.
- **Name:** "SPARK" big in every ad (one of the two largest texts); never "by Everlife" on images.
- Proof wording exact; disclaimer verbatim (the footer handles both).

## Offer, CTAs and claims (from the bible, version 1793905953-bc2f; generated, never edit)
- **Offer:** "Save Up to 51%" is the product's highest discount (bible rule 09; source: CTA). It is the default CTA. Always "Save Up to N%", never a fixed discount, never another product's %.
- **Default CTA:** "Save Up to 51%". **All bible CTAs:** "Explore Spark" · "Ignite Your Spark" · "Save Up to 51%" · "Spark for $1.50/day" · "Ships Free From Pharmacy". The gate refuses any other CTA string.
- **Price CTA (approved alternative; the only $ amount allowed):** "Spark for $1.50/day".
- **Quick-hit benefits (word for word, the only benefit lines):** Brain-Based Desire Support · Non-Hormonal Desire Support · On-Demand Desire Support · Encourages Spontaneous Intimacy · 3-in-1: PT-141 + Apomorphine + Tadalafil · Promotes Desire + Physical Response · Desire Support for Men + Women.
- **Product Hard NOs (bible):** Don’t tie a benefit to any single ingredient — list PT-141, Apomorphine and Tadalafil together as a combo. · Never use “arousal” or any form of it (“aroused,” “arousing”). · Plus all global Hard NOs on page 3.
- **Retired, never use (left the bible or banned):** Get Started Now · Find Your Plan.
- **Disclaimer:** verbatim in `product.json` (= the bible's); the finisher lays it. Exact strings for pasting: `python3 core/scripts/product_copy.py <id>`.
